title: Super Bowl Champion Travis Kelce Reacts To LeBron James Becoming All-Time Leading Scorer
htmlContent:
Travis Kelce, tight end for the Kansas City Chiefs, recently reacted to the news of LeBron James becoming the all-time leading scorer in NBA history. Kelce, who is known for his passion for sports and his love of basketball, was clearly excited about the historic moment.

LeBron James broke the all-time scoring record on February 7, 2023, surpassing Kareem Abdul- Jabbar’s previous record of 38,387 points. The milestone was achieved during a game against the Oklahoma City Thunder, where James scored a fade away jumper to reach 38,390 points.

Kelce, who is a huge LeBron James fan, took to social media to express his excitement and show his support for the NBA star. In a tweet, Kelce wrote, "THE KING!!!@KingJames. They thought it would never be broken!! #TheChosenOne.

Kelce's passion for basketball is well known, and he has previously talked about his admiration for LeBron James and his impact on the sport. Kelce has also talked about how LeBron has inspired him as an athlete and how he has used LeBron's work ethic and dedication to motivate himself in his own career.

LeBron James has had a remarkable career, and his achievement as the all-time leading scorer in NBA history is a testament to his talent, hard work, and dedication. Travis Kelce's reaction to the news is a reflection of the impact that LeBron has had on not just the sport of basketball, but also on the lives of so many people around the world.

In conclusion, the news of LeBron James becoming the all-time leading scorer in NBA history has been met with excitement and admiration from fans and players alike. Travis Kelce's reaction is just one example of the impact that LeBron has had on the sport and on the lives of those who love it.
